definition: A land-management approach that actively rebuilds soil health, ground cover, and water retention over time, typically verified through repeated, dated ecological measurement.
measuredBy: Multi-year baseline and follow-up soil/ground-cover/water measurements per ranch — not yet completed for today's beef supply.
notThis: We do not call today's beef 'regenerative.' Our beef today is grass-fed under the MPCS standard; regenerative is a higher, separately-measured bar we have not yet demonstrated at scale.
